values: UI only: visual design, styling, spacing, typography, existing screen layouts and visual QA.

QA rows cover cross-screen checks; per-task QA covers the individual revised screen or component.
20% contingency covers visual iteration and device differences; no review waiting time is included.
Assume existing assets, English/Khmer support and Android/iOS access; brand approval may change effort.
Edit amber estimates, status and owner on UI Tasks; edit contingency and daily capacity here.
Rows are grouped by delivery phase. Complete dependency IDs before their dependent tasks.
Re-estimate after reviewing mockups and the running app. No start date or deadline has been assumed.
